emails.subject: URGENT - confidential wire needed before noon
emails.body: Hi, I'm in back-to-back board meetings and can't talk. We're closing a time-sensitive acquisition and I need Finance to wire $184,500 to our new escrow partner today before 12pm. I'll send the account details from my personal phone in a follow-up - please treat this as confidential and don't loop in anyone else until it's done. This cannot wait. - James

emails.body: I work in the finance team and I don't want to give my name yet.
